title: Hyperelastic Modeling of Cardiac Tissue Deformation for Data Registration
summary: This work proposes a biomechanical registration framework designed to combine functional optical-mapping data with structural high-resolution MRI of cardiac tissue. The two acquisitions are performed in different mechanical configurations: optical mapping is obtained after stretching the sample, whereas MRI is acquired in a fixed resting state.
